blocks.html:
When a marketing agency wraps its own vehicle, every detail counts. After all, experiential marketing companies live and die by first impressions. That’s exactly why 10 Star Agency Inc. trusted Vinyl Wrap Toronto to transform their Mercedes Sprinter 2500 into a rolling brand statement — and the result speaks for itself.

If you’re a business owner, fleet manager, or marketer in Toronto, Etobicoke, or anywhere across the GTA looking for high-impact Mercedes Sprinter van lettering in Toronto, this project is a masterclass in what professional vinyl decals can do for your brand visibility.

About the Project: 10 Star Agency Inc.’s Mercedes Sprinter 2500

10 Star Agency Inc. is an experiential marketing company that connects brands with their audiences through live, immersive activations. Their Mercedes Sprinter 2500 is more than a work vehicle — it’s a travelling billboard that shows up at events, activations, and high-traffic areas across the GTA.

The brief was clear: bold, clean, unmistakable branding with maximum contrast and impact.

Here’s a quick overview of the job:

What Was Applied: Lettering, Decals & Large-Format Graphics

Looking at the finished van, the design is bold and purposeful. Against the van’s factory gloss black paint, our certified installers applied:

  • Large “10 ★ STAR” wordmark on both the driver and passenger sides, paired with the brand’s logo character
  • Oversized white star graphic spanning the full lower half of the passenger side — a dominant, eye-catching element visible from a distance
  • “EXPERIENTIAL MARKETING” text running across the top rear of the van
  • “10STARAGENCY.COM” URL lettering on both the rear and side panels

Every element was cut and applied using Avery Dennison SW-900 Gloss White vinyl — a premium cast film known for its rich colour saturation, conformability around complex curves, and long-term outdoor durability. The gloss finish creates a vivid contrast against the black base, making the graphics pop in both daylight and under event lighting.

This is exactly the kind of result that premium commercial van decals in the GTA deliver when the design is executed with precision.

Why Lettering & Decals Were the Right Choice for This Van

Many business owners ask whether they should go with a full van wrap, a partial wrap, or lettering and decals. For 10 Star Agency, lettering and decals were the ideal solution for several reasons:

1. The base colour worked in their favour. The Sprinter’s factory black finish served as the “background” of the design. By using Gloss White lettering and graphics on black, the brand achieved a high-contrast, luxury look without needing to wrap the entire vehicle.

2. Cost efficiency without sacrificing impact. Lettering and decals are typically more affordable than a full wrap, yet when designed and installed correctly — as in this case — the visual impact is virtually equal. For marketing agencies and businesses managing vehicle branding budgets across Ontario and Canada, this is a critical advantage.

3. Fast turnaround. Decal and lettering jobs generally require less installation time than full wraps. For a busy marketing agency that needs its Sprinter out on the road and at activations, minimal downtime matters.

4. Easy future updates. If 10 Star Agency ever updates their logo, URL, or brand elements, individual decals and lettering can be removed and replaced without disturbing the rest of the vehicle’s finish.

The Material: Avery Dennison SW-900 Gloss White

Not all vinyl is created equal. For commercial vehicle branding across Toronto, the GTA, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, and beyond, we rely on Avery Dennison premium cast films — and for good reason.

The SW-900 series is Avery’s flagship Supreme Wrapping Film, engineered specifically for vehicle graphics applications. Here’s why it was the right call for this project:

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, all our Avery Dennison and 3M vinyl options are installed by certified technicians, ensuring the adhesion, finish, and longevity meet professional standards.

The Business Case: Why Marketing Companies Should Brand Their Fleet

For a company like 10 Star Agency, the marketing ROI of a branded Sprinter is immediate and ongoing. Here’s what the numbers look like for commercial vehicle branding in Canada:

  • A single wrapped or lettered vehicle in a major Canadian city like Toronto generates an estimated 30,000 to 70,000+ visual impressions per day
  • Vehicle graphics have one of the lowest cost-per-impression rates of any advertising medium — often less than $0.001 per impression
  • Branded vehicles build trust and credibility in local markets — especially for service-based businesses, agencies, and contractors operating across the GTA

For marketing agencies specifically, a branded fleet vehicle is also a live demonstration of what you do. If you’re selling experiential marketing services and showing up in an unbranded van, you’re leaving credibility on the table.

Commercial vehicle wraps and decals are one of the most cost-effective investments a GTA business can make in its brand presence.

Common Mistakes to Avoid With Van Lettering & Decals

Before you book your van lettering in Toronto or anywhere across Ontario, here are a few pitfalls that derail otherwise promising projects:

Choosing the wrong vinyl for your climate. Canada’s freeze-thaw cycles and road salt are brutal on inferior vinyl. Always insist on premium cast films like Avery Dennison or 3M — they’re engineered for outdoor durability in conditions like ours.

Skimping on design. Great vinyl installation cannot save a poor design. Work with a shop that has an in-house design team (like ours) to ensure your graphics are properly scaled, spaced, and formatted for the vehicle’s specific body panels.

Ignoring the base colour. As this 10 Star Agency project demonstrates, your vehicle’s base colour is part of the design. Lettering and decals work best when there’s strong contrast between the base and the graphics.

Choosing an uncertified installer. Improper installation leads to bubbling, lifting edges, and premature failure — especially in Canada’s variable climate. Our installers are certified and experienced with Mercedes Sprinters, transit vans, cargo vans, and all commercial vehicle types.

Frequently Asked Questions About Van Lettering & Decals in Toronto

How much does Mercedes Sprinter van lettering cost in Toronto?

Pricing depends on the complexity, quantity of graphics, and vinyl material used. A basic lettering package for a Sprinter can start at a few hundred dollars, while full large-format graphic packages with custom design work will cost more. Contact us for a free, no-obligation estimate tailored to your vehicle and vision.

How long do commercial van decals last in the GTA?

High-quality cast vinyl like Avery Dennison SW-900 is rated for 7–10 years of outdoor use in conditions like those across Ontario and Canada. With proper care and cleaning, your van lettering should maintain its appearance and adhesion for many years. Vinyl Wrap Toronto also backs all installations with a 3-year warranty against peeling, bubbling, or fading.

Will van lettering damage my vehicle’s paint?

No. Premium vinyl decals and lettering are designed to be paint-safe when applied and removed correctly by a certified professional. In fact, vinyl actually protects the underlying paint from UV rays, minor abrasion, and road debris. When removed by a professional, the paint underneath is typically in better condition than exposed panels.

Can I use lettering and decals on a leased Mercedes Sprinter?

Yes. Lettering and decals are one of the most popular options for leased commercial vehicles precisely because they can be cleanly removed at the end of the lease without affecting the vehicle’s paint or residual value. Always confirm the terms of your lease agreement and work with a certified installer.

What’s the difference between lettering/decals and a full van wrap?

Lettering and decals involve applying pre-cut vinyl text and graphic shapes to specific areas of the vehicle, often using the base paint colour as part of the design. A full wrap covers the entire exterior of the van in a continuous film, allowing for complete colour changes and full-bleed graphic designs. Lettering and decals are more affordable and faster to install; full wraps offer the most dramatic visual transformation. See our full van wrap vs. lettering guide for a detailed comparison.

How long does it take to apply lettering and decals to a van in Etobicoke?

A typical lettering and decals installation on a van like the Mercedes Sprinter 2500 takes one to two days depending on the complexity of the design and number of graphics. Full wraps generally take two to four days. We’ll give you a specific timeline estimate when you come in for your free consultation.

Do you offer van lettering and decals for fleets across the GTA?

Absolutely. We service businesses throughout Toronto, Etobicoke, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, and the wider GTA with both single-vehicle and full fleet branding. Consistent fleet decals across multiple vehicles are one of the most powerful brand-building investments you can make in the Ontario market. Learn more about our commercial vehicle wrap services.
